critic_questions: Does the Name-seed/tree/grave model still survive current canon, and if so how does it distinguish metaphysical Name loss from ordinary memory loss and the Silence?

If Ellison's seed is the Emblem and the Gallowed Man's is the mask in this 2024 brainstorm, how should that older split map onto the confirmed current gestalt without implying two biological identities?
Is Dennis Deacon/Wracken still intended to survive into current continuity, or was his Dream Eater role redistributed to later characters?

The 2022 Pergrande material already places DENIAL and a spell named SHATTERGATE in the same creative lineage, but Shattergate belongs there to Yrys Noelle rather than Eric. Was current Eric/Shattergate/Denial/Silas causality intentionally evolved from this older pairing, and are any thematic rules from the older Shatter Magic meant to survive?

A 2022 pre-Dream-Eater JoJo sheet already uses the exact name Ellison Crane and centers him on a failed suicide attempt that triggers supernatural consequences. Is current Ellison intentionally evolved from this character, and if so is the death/self-destruction motif meant to be retained thematically?
